"""Independent actual docs-companion path controls plus full native gate."""
import argparse
import dataclasses
import datetime
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys
import time

p=argparse.ArgumentParser()
p.add_argument('--worktree',required=True)
p.add_argument('--frozen',required=True)
p.add_argument('--before',required=True)
p.add_argument('--doc-path',required=True)
p.add_argument('--slug',required=True)
a=p.parse_args()
root=Path(a.worktree)
product=root/'policy-engine'
base='c40d4acae1ce58b597267255026d9356565828fd'
def git(*args):
    return subprocess.check_output(['git',*args],cwd=root,text=True)
assert git('rev-parse','HEAD').strip()==a.frozen
working_status=git('status','--porcelain').splitlines()
assert all(line[3:].startswith('policy-engine/docs/research/e02-cloud-test-plan/implementation-handoffs/F/') for line in working_status), working_status
sys.path[:0]=[str(product),str(product/'src')]
from tools.quality.validation.check_docs_gate import build_gate_plan
before_paths=[s.removeprefix('policy-engine/') for s in git('diff','--name-only',base,a.before).splitlines()]
after_paths=[s.removeprefix('policy-engine/') for s in git('diff','--name-only',base,a.frozen).splitlines()]
doc=a.doc_path.removeprefix('policy-engine/')
assert doc in after_paths and doc not in before_paths
before=build_gate_plan(before_paths)
after=build_gate_plan(after_paths)
removed=build_gate_plan([s for s in after_paths if s!=doc])
assert any(f.rule_id=='foundry_docs' for f in before.findings)
assert not any(f.rule_id=='foundry_docs' for f in after.findings)
assert any(f.rule_id=='foundry_docs' for f in removed.findings)
argv=['uv','run','polisyos-tools','validation','check-docs-gate','--repo-root','.',
      '--base-ref',base,'--head-ref',a.frozen]
env=os.environ.copy()
env.update(UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT='/workspace/polisyos/policy-engine/.venv',
           UV_NO_SYNC='1',PYTHONPATH='src:.',PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE='1')
started=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()
clock=time.perf_counter()
result=subprocess.run(argv,cwd=product,env=env,text=True,capture_output=True)
wall=time.perf_counter()-clock
assert result.returncode==1
assert '[foundry_docs]' not in result.stdout+result.stderr
assert 'observed 10' in result.stdout+result.stderr
assert '459cc4ff53c6dcb5cb8444e1bc22c715583f3a69411870176a6bf06bafcdb6be' in result.stdout+result.stderr
assert 'docs freshness exception baseline expired' in result.stdout+result.stderr
assert git('rev-parse','HEAD').strip()==a.frozen
out=Path('/workspace/e02-F-receipts')
log=out/f'F-docs-{a.slug}-independent-after-native.txt'
log.write_text(f'source_sha={a.frozen}\nbase_sha={base}\ncwd={product}\nargv={json.dumps(argv)}\n'
               f'started_utc={started}\nwall_seconds={wall:.6f}\nexit_code={result.returncode}\n'
               f'--- stdout (complete) ---\n{result.stdout}--- stderr (complete) ---\n{result.stderr}')
row=dict(schema='e02.F.docs-companion-independent-review.v1',frozen_sha=a.frozen,
    source_base_sha=base,before_source_sha=a.before,doc_path=a.doc_path,
    before_changed_paths=before_paths,after_changed_paths=after_paths,
    before_plan=dataclasses.asdict(before),after_plan=dataclasses.asdict(after),
    remove_documentation_path_negative=dataclasses.asdict(removed),
    controls='PASS bounded foundry_docs path predicate: before missing / after clear / actual after paths minus document missing',
    implementation_delta_paths=git('diff','--name-only',a.before,a.frozen).splitlines(),
    working_status_at_start=working_status,
    untracked_receipt_boundary='Mutable handoff companions, if recorded, excluded from path planning by explicit immutable head-ref; runtime/tests/reference docs frozen. Freshness does not read these unpublished JSON/TXT bodies.',
    doc_delta=git('diff',a.before,a.frozen,'--',a.doc_path),
    full_native_gate=dict(argv=argv,exit_code=result.returncode,wall_seconds=wall,
      log_path=str(log),log_bytes=log.stat().st_size,log_sha256=hashlib.sha256(log.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
      preserved_failure='expired freshness baseline; observed10/hash459cc; strict_docs_build unrun after child failure'),
    verdict='GO for substantive companion coverage only; whole Docs quality remains FAILED; no estimator/backend/real-data or ledger authority extension')
target=out/f'F-docs-{a.slug}-independent-review.json'
target.write_text(json.dumps(row,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps(dict(review_path=str(target),review_sha256=hashlib.sha256(target.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
    frozen_sha=a.frozen,gate=row['full_native_gate'],controls=row['controls'],verdict=row['verdict']),indent=2))
